natural: a small sign reveals the big picture

meaning.en: From one falling leaf, know that autumn has come: spotting a trend from a small sign.
meaning.zh: 看到一片叶子落下，就知道秋天到了，比喻从细微的迹象预见事物的发展趋势。

examples.zh: 一叶知秋，从这几个订单就能看出市场的变化。
examples.en: A small sign tells the story: these few orders show how the market is shifting.

examples.zh: 有经验的农民能一叶知秋，预判天气。
examples.en: Experienced farmers read the signs and foresee the weather.

story.en: Huainanzi: 'See one leaf fall and know the year is drawing to an end' (见一叶落而知岁之将暮).
story.zh: 《淮南子·说山训》：“见一叶落，而知岁之将暮。”

meaning.en: Two things that depend on and complement each other, as outside and inside.
meaning.zh: 两者相互依存、相互联系。

equivalents: two sides of the same coin

examples.zh: 理论与实践互为表里，缺一不可。
examples.en: Theory and practice are two sides of a coin; neither can do without the other.

examples.zh: 经济发展与环境保护互为表里。
examples.en: Economic development and environmental protection depend on each other.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面、学术语体。

meaning.en: To put on a mysterious act to deceive or scare people.
meaning.zh: 假扮神鬼来吓人或骗人，比喻故意玩弄花招。

examples.zh: 别装神弄鬼了，有话直说。
examples.en: Stop the cloak-and-dagger act and say what you mean.

examples.zh: 那个骗子靠装神弄鬼骗了不少钱。
examples.en: The con man made a lot of money by pretending to supernatural powers.

meaning.en: Things of a kind come together; people with similar traits stick together.
meaning.zh: 同类的东西常聚在一起，比喻志趣相同的人相聚。

equivalents: birds of a feather flock together

examples.zh: 物以类聚，他们几个都爱打篮球。
examples.en: Birds of a feather: all of them love basketball.

examples.zh: 物以类聚，人以群分，你的朋友什么样，你就什么样。
examples.en: Like attracts like; you're known by the company you keep.

story.en: The Book of Changes: 'Things are gathered by kind' (方以类聚).
story.zh: 《周易·系辞上》：“方以类聚，物以群分。”

date.zh: 西周至战国 · 前9—前3世纪
date.en: Western Zhou to Warring States, 9th–3rd c. BC

usage.en: Usually paired with 人以群分.

synonyms: 不是一家人不进一家门
鱼找鱼，虾找虾，乌龟爱王八——气味相投

meaning.en: Victorious everywhere; never defeated.
meaning.zh: 到哪里都能获胜，没有不胜利的。

examples.zh: 这支球队在主场无往不胜。
examples.en: This team is unbeatable at home.

examples.zh: 团结一致，我们就无往不胜。
examples.en: United, we can't be beaten.

natural: make do with what's at hand

meaning.en: To make do with crude, simple facilities rather than ideal ones.
meaning.zh: 就着原来的简陋条件，不求完备地办事。

equivalents: make do with what you have

examples.zh: 创业初期，他们因陋就简，在车库里办公。
examples.en: In the early days they made do, working out of a garage.

examples.zh: 学校条件有限，只能因陋就简。
examples.en: The school's resources are limited, so we have to make do.

meaning.en: To come home disappointed, mood spoiled.
meaning.zh: 兴致被扫，失望地回来。

examples.zh: 下雨了，大家败兴而归。
examples.en: It rained, and everyone went home disappointed.

examples.zh: 他们满怀期待出门，结果败兴而归。
examples.en: They set out full of hope but came back let down.

usage.en: Predicate; contrasts with 乘兴而来.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“乘兴而来”对举。

meaning.en: So preoccupied or shaken that one cannot concentrate.
meaning.zh: 精神恍惚，心神不定，像灵魂离开了身体。

examples.zh: 自从那件事之后，他一直魂不守舍。
examples.en: Ever since that incident he's been distracted.

examples.zh: 考试前她魂不守舍，什么也看不进去。
examples.en: Before the exam she was so on edge she couldn't take anything in.

meaning.en: The words of the matchmaker: traditional arranged marriage.
meaning.zh: 旧时婚姻要经过媒人说合，泛指包办婚姻。

examples.zh: 旧社会的婚姻讲究父母之命，媒妁之言。
examples.en: In the old society marriage depended on parents' orders and the matchmaker's word.

examples.zh: 他们的婚事是媒妁之言，婚后感情却很好。
examples.en: Theirs was a matchmaker's arrangement, yet they grew very close.

usage.en: Usually paired with 父母之命.

meaning.en: To strike while the other side is unprepared.
meaning.zh: 趁对方没有防备的时候行动。

examples.zh: 小偷乘其不备，偷走了钱包。
examples.en: The thief took the wallet while no one was looking.

examples.zh: 部队乘其不备，发起了突袭。
examples.en: The troops launched a surprise attack while the enemy was off guard.

natural: a fine day and fair scenery

meaning.en: A fine time and beautiful scenery.
meaning.zh: 美好的时光和景色。

examples.zh: 良辰美景，不应辜负。
examples.en: Such fine days and lovely scenes should not be wasted.

examples.zh: 春日良辰美景，他们相约踏青。
examples.en: On a fine spring day they arranged a country outing.

origin.source: 谢灵运《拟魏太子邺中集诗序》

story.en: Xie Lingyun's preface: 'Fine times, beautiful scenes, delight of the heart, pleasures of the day' (良辰、美景、赏心、乐事).
story.zh: 谢灵运：“天下良辰、美景、赏心、乐事，四者难并。”

date.zh: 东晋末至南朝宋初 · 5世纪初
date.en: late Eastern Jin to early Liu Song, early 5th c.

usage.en: Often in literary writing; may continue 赏心乐事.
usage.zh: 多用于书面，常接“赏心乐事”。

natural: there is no shortage of precedents

meaning.en: There are plenty of precedents.
meaning.zh: 以前有不少这样的例子。

examples.zh: 这种做法在历史上不乏先例。
examples.en: There is no shortage of precedents for this in history.

examples.zh: 企业转型成功的案例不乏先例。
examples.en: Successful corporate transformations are not unheard of.

pinyin: shēng mǐ zhǔ chéng shú fàn
literal: raw · rice · cooked · into · ripe · rice

meaning.en: Raw rice has been cooked: the matter is settled and cannot be reversed.
meaning.zh: 比喻事情已经做成，不能再改变。

examples.zh: 现在生米煮成熟饭，反对也没用了。
examples.en: It's a done deal now; objecting is pointless.

examples.zh: 他们瞒着家人结了婚，生米煮成熟饭，家人只好接受。
examples.en: They married behind their family's back; it was a fait accompli, and the family had to accept it.

usage.en: Usually 已经/既然 + sentence; colloquial.
usage.zh: 常说“已经生米煮成熟饭”，口语。

meaning.en: Purple vapour comes from the east: a lucky omen of good fortune.
meaning.zh: 紫色的祥云从东方来，比喻吉祥的征兆。

equivalents: good omens are on the way

examples.zh: 新年开门，愿您紫气东来，财源广进。
examples.en: As the new year begins, may good fortune come to you.

examples.zh: 公司选了“紫气东来”作为新楼的名字。
examples.en: The company named its new building 'Purple Energy from the East'.

story.en: Liu Xiang's Lives of the Immortals: purple vapour appeared in the east before Laozi passed through Hangu Pass.
story.zh: 《列仙传》载：老子西游，关令尹喜见紫气东来，知有圣人过关。

date.zh: 西汉 · 前1世纪（托名刘向）
date.en: Western Han, 1st c. BC (attributed to Liu Xiang)

meaning.en: Unmatched in grace and talent in one's era.
meaning.zh: 风采才华超出当代所有人。

examples.zh: 她风华绝代，一代人为之倾倒。
examples.en: Peerless in grace, she captivated a whole generation.

examples.zh: 那位女演员当年风华绝代。
examples.en: That actress was in her day without equal.

natural: pass on by word and example

meaning.en: To teach a skill by oral instruction and personal guidance.
meaning.zh: 用口头讲授和心领神会的方式传授技艺。

equivalents: passed on by word of mouth and example

examples.zh: 这门手艺全靠师傅口传心授。
examples.en: This craft is passed on entirely by the master's personal teaching.

examples.zh: 传统戏曲多是口传心授。
examples.en: Traditional opera is mostly handed down master to pupil.

literal: evil · words · toward each other · add

meaning.en: To hurl abusive words at someone.
meaning.zh: 用恶毒的话骂人、攻击人。

examples.zh: 两人争吵起来，恶语相加。
examples.en: The two quarrelled and hurled insults at each other.

examples.zh: 对待孩子不应恶语相加。
examples.en: One shouldn't hurl harsh words at children.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“对…恶语相加”。

meaning.en: To arrive at exactly the right moment.
meaning.zh: 正赶上那个时候。

equivalents: come at just the right time

examples.zh: 这本书适逢其时，出版后广受欢迎。
examples.en: The book came out at the right moment and was widely welcomed.

examples.zh: 他适逢其时，赶上了互联网热潮。
examples.en: He arrived at just the right time to catch the internet boom.

meaning.en: Neither up nor down; in an awkward in-between position.
meaning.zh: 上不去也下不来，处境尴尬。

examples.zh: 他在公司不上不下，升职没希望。
examples.en: He's stuck in the middle at the company with no hope of promotion.

examples.zh: 这个价位不上不下，不好卖。
examples.en: The price is neither high nor low, so it's hard to sell.

synonyms: 武大郎攀杠子——上不着天，下不着地

meaning.en: To speak and behave in a humble, grovelling way.
meaning.zh: 形容说话小心恭顺，态度卑屈。

examples.zh: 为了拿到订单，他对客户低声下气。
examples.en: To win the order he grovelled to the client.

examples.zh: 不用对他低声下气，我们没做错。
examples.en: No need to be meek with him; we've done nothing wrong.
